visible_evidence: Rust-red stippling increases across inferior iris while pale bands stay visible.
teaching_limit: Color alone does not establish siderosis or an iron foreign body.

label: Large pigmented inferior iris mass
visible_evidence: A bulky irregular brown mass occupies a broad inferior-right sector and deforms iris contour.
teaching_limit: A mass is visible; melanoma and invasion need further examination.

label: Focal pigmented inferior-right iris mass
visible_evidence: A smaller textured mass near 4-5 o'clock deforms iris contour beside exposed bands.
teaching_limit: Teach mass recognition rather than histologic diagnosis or invasion.

label: Circumferential red canal-like line
visible_evidence: A narrow unbranched red line follows the posterior trabecular region without a free blood level.
teaching_limit: Canal blood is plausible if the line lies anterior to the spur; localization and cause require confirmation.

label: Broad pale posterior angle band
visible_evidence: A wide pale-gray posterior band with fine vessels surrounds iris beside anterior landmarks.
teaching_limit: Excessive pallor and duplicated-looking boundaries limit calibration use.

label: Broad brown posterior angle band

teaching_limit: Useful for vessel-plane comparison, not a diagnosis of interstitial keratitis or NVA.

teaching_limit: Supports recession, not PDS; trauma history and fellow-eye comparison add clinical confirmation.
